name: Mem
description: Give Claude the full context of your second brain by connecting your Mem knowledge base. Search your AI notebook for context, capture and recall ideas, save chats into new notes, edit and update living docs, and organize your AI workspace — simply by asking Claude. Use for: synthesizing and pulling actions items from meeting notes, deep research, personal knowledge management (PKM), knowledge repository building, task management, prioritization, and content development. Example prompts: "Search my notes for pricing strategy and validate our thinking with research." "Create a note from this chat and add it to our GTM collection." "List all open tasks from this week's notes and add to my to-do list."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mem to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mem.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mem MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mem lists 15 MCP tools, including list_notes, create_note, search_notes, get_note, update_note, trash_note, restore_note, delete_note, list_collections, create_collection, search_collections, and get_collection.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mem?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mem in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Mem requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mem is developed by Mem Labs, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
